mapper.sql: select e.cruise_result_id, f.cruise_data_id, e.device_id, e.device_name, b.device_mete_id, h.instance_id, e.instance_name, b.mete_type, q.dict_note as mete_type_name, f.evaluation_state, p.dict_note as evaluation_state_name, f.result_num, f.picpath, f.cruise_result, g.dict_note as cruise_result_name, e.cruise_time, a.real_code, f.person_check, f.identify_result, z.dict_note as identify_result_name, f.cruise_type FROM t_cruise_data_result f LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail e on e.cruise_result_id = f.cruise_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_info h on h.instance_id = e.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b on b.device_mete_id = h.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device a on a.device_id = b.device_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business g on g.dict_code = f.cruise_result AND g.col_name = 'cruise_result' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business p on p.dict_code = f.evaluation_state and p.col_name = 'evaluation_state' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business q on q.dict_code = b.mete_type and q.col_name = 'mete_type' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business z on z.dict_code = f.identify_result and z.col_name = 'identify_result'

select q.task_id, e.cruise_result_id, f.cruise_data_id, e.device_id, e.device_name, b.device_mete_id, e.instance_id, e.instance_name, b.mete_type, w.dict_note as mete_type_name, f.evaluation_state, x.dict_note as evaluation_state_name, f.result_num, f.picpath, F.cruise_result, g.dict_note as cruise_result_name, e.cruise_time, y.real_code, f.person_check, f.identify_result, z.dict_note as identify_result_name, f.cruise_type from t_cruise_result q LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail e on q.task_result_id = e.task_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_data_result f on e.cruise_result_id = f.cruise_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_info h on h.instance_id = e.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b on b.device_mete_id = h.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device y on y.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business g on g.dict_code = f.cruise_result and g.col_name = 'cruise_result' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business w on w.dict_code = b.mete_type and w.col_name = 'mete_type' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business x on x.dict_code = f.evaluation_state and x.col_name = 'evaluation_state' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business z on z.dict_code = f.identify_result and z.col_name = 'identify_result'
mapper.delete: delete from t_report_info WHERE report_id = #{reportId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: insert into t_report_info( report_id, report_name, report_type, generate_date, report_env_id, remarks )values( #{reportId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reportName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reportType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{generateDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{reportEnvId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remarks, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT a.region_name FROM t_std_region a WHERE a.up_region_id = -1

SELECT dict_note as meteType, (SELECT COUNT(*) from (
where 1 = 1 and a.device_id in
#{deviceIds, jdbcType=BIGINT}
and cruise_time between #{startTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and #{endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} GROUP BY device_mete_id ) big_table where mete_type = dict_code ) as meteNum, 0 as regular_num from t_dict_business where dict_code IN ( select dict_code from t_dict_business where col_name = 'mete_type' ) ORDER BY dict_code

SELECT dict_note as meteType, (SELECT COUNT(*) from (
where 1 = 1 and task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY device_mete_id ) big_table where mete_type = dict_code ) as meteNum, 0 as regular_num from t_dict_business where dict_code IN ( select dict_code from t_dict_business where col_name = 'mete_type' ) ORDER BY dict_code

select q.task_id, e.cruise_result_id, f.cruise_data_id, e.device_id, e.device_name, b.device_mete_id, e.instance_id, e.instance_name, b.mete_type, w.dict_note as mete_type_name, f.evaluation_state, x.dict_note as evaluation_state_name, f.result_num, f.picpath as picPath, F.cruise_result, g.dict_note as cruise_result_name, e.cruise_time, a.real_code, f.person_check, f.identify_result, z.dict_note as identify_result_name, f.cruise_type, n.dict_note as dataType, b.custom_id, b.custom_name as componentName, a.up_region_name as intervalName, m.region_name as regionName from t_cruise_result q LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail e on q.task_result_id = e.task_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_data_result f on e.cruise_result_id = f.cruise_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_info h on h.instance_id = e.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b on b.device_mete_id = h.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business g on g.dict_code = f.cruise_result and g.col_name = 'cruise_result' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business w on w.dict_code = b.mete_type and w.col_name = 'mete_type' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business x on x.dict_code = f.evaluation_state and x.col_name = 'evaluation_state' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business z on z.dict_code = f.identify_result and z.col_name = 'identify_result' LEFT JOIN t_std_device a on a.device_id = b.device_id LEFT JOIN t_std_region d on d.region_id = a.up_region_id LEFT JOIN t_std_region m on m.region_id = d.up_region_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business n on n.dict_code = f.cruise_type and n.col_name = 'cruise_type' where 1 = 1 and task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER by cruise_time

SELECT a.task_name, a.start_time as cruise_date, d.task_count as total, d.task_wait as wait, d.task_count - task_wait as already, b.task_abnormal as abnormal, d.task_count - b.task_abnormal as normal, (SELECT count(1) from t_cruise_data_result WHERE e.check_user IS NULL)as unReview, MIN(f.cruise_time) as cruiseStartTime, MAX(f.end_time) as cruiseEndTime, d.check_user as reviewer, d.check_date as reviewTime from t_cruise_task a,t_cruise_result d,t_cruise_task_result b,t_cruise_task_result_detail f,t_cruise_data_result e where 1 = 1 and a.task_id = d.task_id and d.task_result_id = b.task_result_id and b.task_result_id = f.task_result_id and f.cruise_result_id = e.cruise_result_id and a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT a.remark FROM t_cruise_result a where 1 = 1 and a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
